description:
With the Rise series, Mongoose offers pro-level, stylish complete freestyle scooters for the best value on the market! Our highest end model, the Rise 110 Team Freestyle Scooter, is loaded with outstanding features, including a lightweight alloy deck with extended standing area, quadruple anodized CNC clamp collar, internal sealed threadless headset, and CNC alloy fork. Stand out at the stakepark with the Rise 110 Team.
Lightweight alloy deck with extended standing area for pro-style scooter performance.
Alloy deck and brake combine with 110 mm high impact alloy wheels and durable ABEC-9 bearings.
One-piece welded ultra-lightweight aluminum T-bar handlebar with bike-style grips.
Quadruple anodized CNC clamp collar with sealed internal threadless headset, and CNC alloy fork.
Heavy-duty frame supports riders ages 8+, up to 220 lbs.
